title: keyrack del strips every comment from keyrack.yml
description:
## .what

`rhx keyrack del --env prep --key <name>` rewrites `.agent/keyrack.yml` and drops every comment
in the file, not just the deleted key's lines.

## .why it matters

keyrack.yml comments are the only docs for why each key exists (which wish reads it, which
token kind, what scope). one del erased all of them across every env; the human only learns of
it from a diff.

## .repro

1. keyrack.yml with commented keys under `env.prep` and `env.test`
2. `rhx keyrack del --owner ehmpath --env prep --key SOME_KEY`
3. `git diff .agent/keyrack.yml` — every comment is gone

## .the shape of the fix

edit the yaml via a parser that keeps comments (e.g. the `yaml` Document api), and remove only
the target key's line (plus a comment block directly above it, if any). clamp: a del leaves
every other line byte-identical.
